legend: Alice and Bob are playing a turn-based game. The rules of the game are as follows:
At the beginning of the game some binary string s$$$s$$$ is chosen.

On his turn player has to choose some substring t$$$t$$$ of s$$$s$$$, equal to one of 10, 110, 100, 1010. Then the player has to reverse t$$$t$$$. For example, if s=$$$s = $$$ 010101, the player can select substring t=$$$t = $$$ 1010 and reverse it, obtaining s=$$$s = $$$ 001011
The player who can't make a move (who can't choose an appropriate substring t$$$t$$$) loses.
The players cannot skip a turn.

A string a$$$a$$$ is a substring of a string b$$$b$$$ if a$$$a$$$ can be obtained from b$$$b$$$ by deletion of several (possibly, zero or all) characters from the beginning and several (possibly, zero or all) characters from the end.
input: The only line of the input contains a binary string s$$$s$$$ (1≤|s|≤106$$$1 \le |s| \le 10^6$$$) — the string with which Alice and Bob play.
output: If Alice wins, output Alice. Otherwise, output Bob.
note: In the first sample, Alice can choose substring 10 of 010 and reverse it, obtaining string 001. Bob can't make any move with this string, and loses.
In the second sample, Alice can't make a single move and loses.

无法进行操作的玩家(无法选择合适的子串 t$$$t$$$)输掉游戏。
如果可以通过从 b$$$b$$$ 的开头删除若干个(可能为零个或全部)字符，并从末尾删除若干个(可能为零个或全部)字符得到 a$$$a$$$，则字符串 a$$$a$$$ 是字符串 b$$$b$$$ 的子串。

input.ai: 输入仅一行，包含一个 01 串 s$$$s$$$(1≤|s|≤106$$$1 \le |s| \le 10^6$$$)——Alice 和 Bob 用来进行游戏的字符串。
